REVIEW_READY

The producer completes this handoff for a different eligible provider. The Director posts or prompts the review assignment in the project thread. This record requests independent review; it does not approve or merge the work. Do not place secrets, credentials, tokens, or raw private source in this handoff. Workflow skills are procedure overlays, not permission grants.

Candidate identity

  • Project/task: <project ID and Director task ID>
  • Assignment: <producer assignment ID>
  • Logical producer: <provider>
  • Material authors: <all providers/people that materially shaped the artifact>
  • Repository: <exact owner/name or not applicable>
  • Base branch/ref: <exact durable ref>
  • Target-tip base_sha: <PR current target-tip, exact 40-hex SHA; exact-candidate binding>
  • Review merge_base_sha: <exact 40-hex SHA; merge base base used for the reviewed diff>
  • Head branch: <candidate branch>
  • Head SHA: <exact 40-hex SHA>
  • Artifact digest: <digest when not SHA-bound>
  • Pull request: <canonical draft PR URL or none>

Scope and evidence

  • Changed files/artifact scope: <complete list or canonical manifest>
  • Outcome delivered: <what changed>
  • Acceptance checks: <check and result>
  • Tests: <exact commands/checks and results>
  • Security context: <risk surface, scan evidence, or why not applicable>
  • Known limitations: <limitations and uncertainty>
  • Unresolved findings: <none or explicit list>

Reviewer request

  • Eligible reviewer: <different provider>
  • Reviewer workflow skill: <cursor-agent-workflow or none>
  • Requested depth: <focused, full diff, exact-SHA, security-adjacent, etc.>
  • Required verdict: ACCEPT, CHANGES_REQUIRED, or SERIOUS_SAFETY_STOP
  • Merge path after acceptance: <configured deterministic gate and required CI/security>
  • Candidate invalidation: Any base_sha, merge_base_sha, head SHA, or artifact change voids this handoff and all review, security, CI, and merge evidence tied to it.

Provider-to-provider prompt

REVIEW_REQUEST
Project: <project ID>
Task/assignment: <task ID> / <review assignment ID>
Review exact candidate: <repository>
Target-tip base_sha: <PR current target-tip, exact 40-hex SHA; exact-candidate binding>
Review merge_base_sha: <exact 40-hex SHA; base used for the reviewed diff>
Head SHA: <exact 40-hex SHA or artifact digest>
Producer/material authors: <names>
PR URL: <pull-request URL or none>
Author/independence evidence: <ordinary Git and authenticated run references; no prescribed header or share table>
Scope: <changed files or artifact scope>
Acceptance evidence: <concise exact evidence>
Known limitations/security context: <concise details>
Bind the review to the actual target-tip base_sha, merge_base_sha and head SHA.
Verify actual producer/contributor identities and reviewer independence from
existing Git and authenticated run evidence. No custom attribution headers,
trailers or percentage/share paperwork is required (owner, 2026-10-01).
A real identity conflict must be reconciled; never invent evidence.
Return only: ACCEPT, CHANGES_REQUIRED, or SERIOUS_SAFETY_STOP, followed by
evidence and actionable findings.
Do not review a PR candidate whose sole author is you or shares your provider
family. An assisting contributor may review under the owner rule, subject to
the material-author gate limitations above. Under the owner's merge law, the
thorough non-contributing reviewer merges after an exact-SHA ACCEPT and green
checks; no contributor merges, including one with only uncounted maintenance.
Immediately before an authorized merge, run the current merge preflight on
the exact PR, full head SHA and reviewer family. Use only the command it prints
on success. The owner lifted the temporary B2 hold; retain current live holds
and every deterministic gate. A refusing runtime gate remains a concrete
blocker to report and reconcile, never a check to bypass.
Do not deploy, publish, change access, or infer authority from this request.

Reviewer result

  • Reviewer/provider: <provider>
  • Authenticated run/session: <run ID or callback identity>
  • Reviewed target-tip base_sha: <exact 40-hex SHA or n/a for artifact-only review>
  • Reviewed merge_base_sha: <exact 40-hex SHA or n/a for artifact-only review>
  • Reviewed head SHA or artifact digest: <exact 40-hex SHA or digest>
  • Verdict: <ACCEPT / CHANGES_REQUIRED / SERIOUS_SAFETY_STOP>
  • Evidence/findings: <concise result>
  • Current CI/security evidence: <exact status or pending>
  • Next responsible party: <producer, deterministic gate, Director, or owner>

Owner direction, 2026-10-01: contribution-documentation, tagging and acknowledgement procedures are discontinued. Do not require custom commit trailers, mandatory contribution headers or percentage/share paperwork. Preserve normal Git Author/Committer provenance, actual provider identity and ordinary task/review evidence. Independent review, contributor/merger separation and every existing deterministic gate remain in force. The authenticated run/session, exact candidate, independent verdict, current CI/security evidence, and deterministic policy gates remain authoritative.
